name: iikoCloud integration for WooCommerce
author: Max

sections.description:
iiko is Your All-in-One POS & Restaurant Management Software, providing comprehensive solutions for restaurant and retail management.
iikoCloud API (iikoTransport API) serves as a single point of access to the functionality provided by iiko.

This plugin offers a robust integration solution that includes:

  • Product Management

    • Import of organization, terminals, and nomenclature (categories, goods, and dishes)
    • Support for product categories and attributes
    • Automatic product updates and synchronization

  • Order Processing

    • Export of orders (deliveries or kitchen orders)
    • Real-time order status updates
    • Support for multiple delivery methods

  • Payment Integration

    • Support for various payment types
    • Integration with WooCommerce payment gateways
    • Custom payment method handling

  • Location Management

    • Import of cities and streets
    • Delivery zone management
    • Address validation and verification

The Premium version of the plugin includes the following advanced features:

  • Advanced Product Management

    • Variable product support with sizes and modifiers
    • Automatic import scheduling via WP CRON
    • Enhanced product categorization

  • Checkout Customization

    • Customizable checkout fields
    • Delivery method selection
    • Order type selection (delivery/kitchen)

  • Loyalty System

    • Bonus program integration
    • Customer rewards management
    • Points calculation and redemption

  • Additional Features

    • Multiple shipping methods (pickup and courier)
    • Table management with QR codes
    • Stop list support via webhooks
    • Lifetime license for a domain
    • Free updates and installation support

For detailed documentation and guides, visit our Documentation.

Requirements

  1. WooCommerce: The plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.
  2. API Configuration: The apiLogin setting must be configured in WooCommerce -> Settings -> iikoCloud -> General.

To get the Premium version of the plugin, contact us via:
– Email: hi@wpwc.ru
– Telegram: WPWC_iikoCloud_Bot
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “iikoCloud integration for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Click Upload Plugin
  3. Select the wc-iikocloud.zip file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Using FTP (Not Recommended)

  1. Download wc-iikocloud.zip
  2. Extract the wc-iikocloud folder
  3. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate via WordPress admin
sections.faq:
I need more information about the plugin

For comprehensive information about the plugin, visit:
– Website: en.wpwc.ru
– Email: hi@wpwc.ru
– Telegram: WPWC_iikoCloud_Bot

Is there a Trial Premium version of the plugin?

Yes, we offer a trial version of the Premium plugin. To request access:
– Email: hi@wpwc.ru
– Telegram: WPWC_iikoCloud_Bot

How to use Syrve API instead of iiko one?

To switch to Syrve API:
1. Navigate to WooCommerce -> Settings -> iikoCloud -> General
2. Locate the Syrve API checkbox
3. Enable the checkbox
4. Save the settings
